# lerpWrapDeg

## Summary

Smoothstep-interpolates the display hue angle (`HUE_DEG`, in HSL degrees) at a fractional hue position `h` in `[0, 1)`, taking the short way around the 360° circle so interpolation never sweeps through the wrong hues. Returns a degree value normalized to `[0, 360)`.

## Import

```javascript
import { lerpWrapDeg } from '../utils/munsell';
```

## Usage

```javascript
let deg = lerpWrapDeg(0.05); // display angle between 5R and 5YR
```
